description: This file defines the 'Column' class for PySpark SQL, including methods for column operations, transformations, and expression building within Spark DataFrames.

classes.name: Column
classes.description: Represents a column expression in Spark SQL, supporting various operations, transformations, and expression building.

methods.name: _create_column_from_literal
methods.description: Creates a JVM column from a literal value.

methods.name: _create_column_from_name
methods.description: Creates a JVM column from a column name.

methods.name: _to_java_column
methods.description: Converts a Column or string to a JVM column object.

methods.name: _to_seq
methods.description: Converts a list of columns or names into a JVM sequence.

methods.name: _to_list
methods.description: Converts a list of columns or names into a JVM list.

methods.name: _unary_op
methods.description: Creates a unary operation on a column.

methods.name: _func_op
methods.description: Creates a function operation on a column.

methods.name: _bin_func_op
methods.description: Creates a binary function operation on columns.

methods.name: _bin_op
methods.description: Creates a binary operation on columns.

methods.name: _reverse_op
methods.description: Creates a reversed binary operation with the column on the right.

methods.name: Column
methods.description: Represents a Spark SQL column expression with methods for operations and transformations.

methods.name: _test
methods.description: Runs doctests for the Column class.
